parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA

figures.quote: Adjusted EBITDA was $133.5 million for the quarter, up $13.6 million, or up 11.4%, from the same period in 2025, driven by both acquisition contribution and organic growth .

parsed.notes: The excerpt cuts off the reconciliation table before its Adjusted EBITDA row, so the only figure is the Q3 2026 amount from the narrative text. The Q3 2025 amount (implied about $119.9 million from the $13.6 million increase) and the nine-month figures are not printed, so they are not reported. The FY2026 guidance range of $475-$481 million is a forecast, not a reported result, and is excluded.
